name: premise-check
description: A Haiku side agent watches the session for claims about libraries, frameworks and versions made from stale training data, and gets them checked.

action.title: When the watcher flags a claim
action.description: nudge: tell the main agent to verify it. verify: an independent checker subagent looks it up and tells the main agent only if it was wrong. ask: show it above the prompt and let you choose. off: watch nothing.

watcherModel.title: Watcher model
watcherModel.description: Model that reads the session and spots stale-knowledge claims.

checkerModel.title: Checker model
checkerModel.description: Model the verifying subagent (with web access) runs on.

everySteps.title: Watch every N model steps
everySteps.description: During a long turn, how many model requests pass between checks. Every turn's end is always checked.
